therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: amyloid plaque clearance / reduction of amyloid burden
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Safety and tolerability (AEs, SAEs, physical/neurological/vital/ECG/lab changes) and change from baseline in MMSE score

results.effect_size: MMSE change at Week 52: bapineuzumab 0.15 mg/kg −2.4, 0.5 mg/kg −3.8, 1.0 mg/kg −0.7, 2.0 mg/kg −1.2 vs placebo −2.9
results.target_engagement_evidence: Plasma amyloid-beta (x-40) concentrations increased dose-dependently after bapineuzumab infusion (e.g., at 24h: 0.15 mg/kg 1474 pg/mL, 0.5 mg/kg 3581 pg/mL, 1.0 mg/kg 5333 pg/mL, 2.0 mg/kg 7405 pg/mL vs placebo 302 pg/mL), consistent with antibody-mediated redistribution of Aβ from brain to plasma.
biomarker_changes: Plasma Aβ(x-40) increased dose-dependently in all bapineuzumab arms vs placebo, peaking at 6–24 hours post-infusion and returning toward baseline by ~4368 hours
No anti-bapineuzumab antibodies detected in any participant across all dose cohorts
Serum bapineuzumab Cmax was dose-proportional: 3.32, 11.1, 21.0, 61.0 mcg/mL for 0.15, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0 mg/kg respectively
Mean serum half-life ranged from 15.0 to 28.1 days across dose cohorts
Systemic clearance was consistent across doses (~6.88–8.84 mL/hour)
safety_signals: Treatment-emergent AEs occurred in 5/6 (0.15 mg/kg), 3/6 (0.5 mg/kg), 6/6 (1.0 mg/kg), 3/6 (2.0 mg/kg), and 7/8 (placebo) participants
No SAEs reported in any arm
No clinically significant changes in physical or neurological examinations in any bapineuzumab arm
No clinically significant ECG findings in any bapineuzumab arm
Potentially clinically important vital signs in 2 (0.15 mg/kg), 0 (0.5 mg/kg), 2 (1.0 mg/kg), 1 (2.0 mg/kg) participants
Potentially clinically important laboratory results in 6 (0.15 mg/kg), 4 (0.5 mg/kg), 3 (1.0 mg/kg), 5 (2.0 mg/kg) participants

adverse_events.term: Clinically significant changes in physical examinations
Clinically significant changes in neurological examinations
